metadata.title: jam-actions-v1-probe — evaluation-only near-gate acoustic takes
metadata.description: 24 acoustic takes on jam-actions-v1's three held-out songs, each measured within 10 ms or 5 cents of a grading gate, both signs of both quantities. Never split, never trained on. Distinguishes a model that compares a measurement to a gate from one that reads a sign.
metadata.notes: Evaluation-only. Never merge into a training set. Never split. Cite the concept DOI and name the version.
